name: ZSF_DS_METRIC_DEFN
description: This table contains the source tables from which metrics will be computed in Sales Forecasting.

columns.name: METRIC_DEFN_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for metric definition id

columns.name: METRIC_CODE
columns.description: Code that identifies the metric in CX Sales Forecasting.

columns.name: METRIC_SRC_CODE
columns.description: Foreign key from ZSF_DS_METRIC_SRC, providing the source table and filter criteria for the metric being defined.

columns.name: METRIC_CRITERIA
columns.description: If there are any additional criteria to be considered for this metric specifically, they can be included in this column.

columns.name: CUSTOM_METRIC_CRITERIA_EXPR
columns.description: Custom metric criteria in the form of a rules engine expression

columns.name: METRIC_SRC_COLUMN
columns.description: Source Column or formula from the metric source that provides the value for this metric

columns.name: CUSTOM_METRIC_SRC_COLUMN_EXPR
columns.description: Metric source column in the form of an object attribute based expression

columns.name: AGGREGATE_FUNCTION
columns.description: Type of SQL aggregate function to be used while computing this metric

columns.name: ADJUSTABLE_FLAG
columns.description: Y / NULL to indicate if the metric definition is adjustable or not

columns.name: DEPND_METRIC_CODE_LIST
columns.description: Dependent metric codes list separated by commas.

columns.name: STATUS_CODE
columns.description: This column will determine if a metric is available and is to be computed.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
